text:
jamie (eng-ml): Quick heads-up — I'm starting onboarding for zeta-13b-qa weights. HF source: https://huggingface.co/org/zeta/13b . Plan: mirror to s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta/13b/v1 and add registry entry. Need a quick gate checklist: presigned URL test, checksum match, tokenizer sanity, config lint. any blockers?

marie (eng-ml): @jamie do we have tokenizer files in the HF repo? Last time zeta variants had both sentencepiece.model and tokenizer.json which caused conflicts. Also note the vocab size mismatch we saw on zeta-7b.

ops-bot: mirror-job queued: mirror-1932104567-zeta-13b -> s3://redwood-staging/zeta/13b/v1. presign TTL default 3600s. will post the job id once copied.

sam (eng-ml): remind me the checksum algorithm we enforce? sha256? and CI will reject if digest mismatch?

kevin (eng-infra): We use sha256 for weights and sha1 for some legacy manifests. CI lint script checks sha256(weights) == manifest.sha256 and tokenizer files presence. Example command:
```
tools/check_artifact.sh --path s3://redwood-staging/zeta/13b/v1 --expect-sha256 manifest.json
```

marie (eng-ml): Tokenizer sanity: run tokenization roundtrip on a small prompt set. If tokenizer.json and sentencepiece both present, prefer tokenizer.json and validate special tokens. Quick script:
```
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json'); print(t.encode('hello world'))"
```

jamie (eng-ml): I'll run checks after mirror completes. Can someone add an access grant for the onboarding team to the bucket? @kevin

kevin (eng-infra): Added IAM group redwood-onboarders with s3:GetObject, ListBucket on s3://redwood-staging/zeta/13b/* . Logged in terraform-patch: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/412
Also set presign TTL to 12h for onboarding (temp) — change will be reverted after vetting.

ops-bot: mirror-job completed. job-id: mj-98765. copied 12 objects. posted manifest at s3://redwood-staging/zeta/13b/v1/manifest.json

jamie (eng-ml): Running CI lint now. Will report results here. thx :thumbsup:
